blocks.title: Top 5 by the scanner's score · 29 Oct
blocks.note: Reward:risk is the first target's R multiple, before charges. Ideas keep the scanner's rank: its rules-based score, which is a rank and not a probability. Within an idea, `preferred` is the viable strategy with the best net reward : risk at the conservative level. Reward : risk of a hedged or income structure (a long put or a short call changes the loss at the stop) is not comparable with an unhedged one: read max loss and capital at risk beside it. No probability and no composite score is produced. Strong results add up to +5 points; weak results make no adjustment (tested on four past results seasons; confirmation pending). With Chartink included, ideas the AI scanner lists come first, ranked by its score; stocks only Chartink listed follow them, ranked by the number of your enabled bullish Chartink scans that listed them and then by traded value. A scan count is not a probability and not a score; your Chartink scans are your own screens and have not been validated.
